title: On Task-Restricted Virtual Sensors: Reproduction, Infeasibility Interval, Non-Factorisation, and the Rate-Side Ladder
summary: Task-restricted remote sensing asks for the cheapest virtual sensor whose information matrix lies in a given admissible cone. On the published four-state example, the plotted rate–cost frontiers are optima over the whole cone, including its rank-deficient boundary, to within $0.07$ cost units inside the digitisation band, whereas no isotropic-noise family reaches them ($1.11$–$16.4$ units above).
